new_findings.title: ADR-0030 constraint 9 creates a registration deadlock
new_findings.basis: Constraint 9 requires a new ADR revision AND that constraint 7 be released (which requires real independent-failure-domain verification at :957 and a formal Task registration at :958) before an implementation card may be registered.
new_findings.impact: S4.23/S4.24 implementation cards are permanently unregisterable; ADR-0032 :1122 claim of no architecture deadlock only covers the pre-revision case; F005 is substantively unresolved.
new_findings.recommendation: Split into decision card (produces ADR-0030 r03, documentation only), implementation/verification card (registerable after r03 acceptance, produces real evidence), and production-release card (after full constraint 7 evidence + human approval). Change constraint 9 entry to 'decision revision accepted'.
new_findings.closureCondition: Revised text yields an acyclic registerable sequence with verifiable preconditions, and implementation/verification cards are registerable after r03.

new_findings.title: Candidate S4.24 has conflicting identities
new_findings.location: framework.md:1048 (ADR-0031: restore implementation card); framework.md:1119-1120 (ADR-0032: exclusive lock wiring, requires S4.23); gap-map.md:182 (restore + deployed exclusive OS backend)
new_findings.basis: The same candidate number is assigned different implementation scopes and gates in three places; ADR-0032 release chain :1116-1121 omits the restore half entirely.
new_findings.impact: No single S4.24 card can satisfy both ADR-0031 and ADR-0032 gates; registering it creates a contract conflict and the restore half has no release-chain承接.
new_findings.recommendation: Split into S4.24a (restore source/target/tool) and S4.24b (deployment exclusive lock wiring), rename consistently in ADR-0031/0032 and gap-map; S4.24b requires S4.23; S4.22 after both.
new_findings.closureCondition: Three definitions agree and the release chain covers both restore and lock-wiring nodes.

new_findings.title: Adoption record has swapped section/line anchors
new_findings.basis: Writes section 4 :191 and section 3.2 :207, but gap-map section 3.2 starts at :185 (:191 in 3.2) and section 4 starts at :193 (:207 in 4); anchors and quoted text are swapped.
new_findings.impact: Readers checking the anchors land on the wrong section; adoption conclusion unaffected.
new_findings.closureCondition: Anchors match sections and quoted text.

new_findings.title: Standing authorization source date/location not verifiable in evidence
new_findings.basis: Claims the user repeated the standing authorization in a 2026-11-02 session, but no dated/located record exists in the evidence dir; the repo only shows a 2026-10-31 instance.
new_findings.impact: The adoption record source cannot be independently replayed; weakens auditability but does not reopen F002.
new_findings.recommendation: Add the concrete session/message pointer or cite the verifiable 2026-10-31 instance.
new_findings.closureCondition: A verifiable dated source pointer is recorded.

new_findings.title: ADR r02 revision date precedes its triggering report
new_findings.basis: All say 2026-11-01 r02 revision, but the triggering planning-review-r01/report.md:8 is dated 2026-11-02; actual mtimes are 2026-11-02 00:50:59 and 00:55:17.
new_findings.impact: Traceability shows revision before trigger; audit ordering may be misread.
new_findings.recommendation: Change to 2026-11-02 or state decision date 2026-11-01 / revision date 2026-11-02.
new_findings.closureCondition: Revision dates are not earlier than the triggering report.
